name: clip-share
note: seconds in the encoded mp4/gif (load lead trimmed; first caption at 0.15 s). caption_end_sec is when the NEXT action (scroll or click) begins, minus 0.1 s, not the next mark (DA, Oct 31); a short uncaptioned gap between windows is expected.

captionWindows.label: s1 Share statement in frame (0 s caption)
s2 share sheet open, Include cost off (3 s caption)
s3 hold on card preview and footer (9 s caption, 'device' wording)
s4 highlight Save image then Share (14 s caption)
s5 hold last frame, end card (18 s caption)

notes: Marks are placed AFTER the screen state is reached.

The navigator.share API is stubbed so the iPhone-style 'Share' button renders; the Share button is highlighted but NEVER clicked, so no 'Shared'/'Sent' state appears and nothing is shared or sent (DA condition).
